Load libraries
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
```


Load data
```{r, message=FALSE}
# List all files matching pattern
files <- list.files(pattern = "^GO_Genes_MDD_all_genes_.*\\.csv$")

# Read files into a named list
go_list <- lapply(files, read_csv2)

# Name the list elements based on the part after "GO_Genes_MDD_all_genes_" and before ".csv"
names(go_list) <- sub("^GO_Genes_MDD_all_genes_(.*)\\.csv$", "\\1", files)

# Check
names(go_list)

```



# Plot

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=8}
# Desired order
group_order <- c("NSC", "INP", "NB", "YGN", "GN")

# Assign custom colors
group_colors <- c("NSC" = "#FC8D62", 
                  "INP" = "#E78AC3", 
                  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB", 
                  "YGN" = "#A6D854", 
                  "GN"  = "#66C2A5")

# Prepare a combined dataframe
combined_df <- lapply(group_order, function(g) {
  df <- go_list[[g]]
  
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    df <- tibble(
      term_name = "No data",
      p_value = NA,
      intersection_size = NA,
      term_size = NA,
      group = g
    )
  } else {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        p_value = as.numeric(p_value),
        intersection_size = as.numeric(intersection_size),
        term_size = as.numeric(term_size),
        group = g
      )
  }
  
  df[1:min(10, nrow(df)), ]
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Make group a factor to preserve order
combined_df$group <- factor(combined_df$group, levels = group_order)

# Reorder term labels by group and p-value
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(term_label = ifelse(is.na(p_value), "No data", term_name)) %>%
  arrange(group, desc(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(term_label = factor(paste(group, term_label, sep = ": "), 
                             levels = paste(group, term_label, sep = ": ")))

# Plot with colored fills
p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(
      y = term_label,
      x = -log10(p_value),
      size = intersection_size / term_size,
      fill = group
    )) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "grey30") +  # color = border, fill = group
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "-log10(adj.p-value)",
    y = "Biological Processes",
    size = "Gene Ratio",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  ggtitle("MDD genetically associated genes among DEGs") +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

cowplot::plot_grid(p, ncol = 1)

```


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# Desired order
group_order <- c("NSC", "INP", "NB", "YGN", "GN")

# Assign custom colors
group_colors <- c("NSC" = "#FC8D62", 
                  "INP" = "#E78AC3", 
                  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB", 
                  "YGN" = "#A6D854", 
                  "GN"  = "#66C2A5")

# Prepare a combined dataframe
combined_df <- lapply(group_order, function(g) {
  df <- go_list[[g]]
  
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    df <- tibble(
      term_name = "No data",
      p_value = NA,
      intersection_size = NA,
      term_size = NA,
      group = g
    )
  } else {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        p_value = as.numeric(p_value),
        intersection_size = as.numeric(intersection_size),
        term_size = as.numeric(term_size),
        group = g
      )
  }
  
  df[1:min(10, nrow(df)), ]
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Make group a factor to preserve order
combined_df$group <- factor(combined_df$group, levels = group_order)

# Reorder term labels by group and p-value
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(term_label = ifelse(is.na(p_value), "No data", term_name)) %>%
  arrange(group, desc(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(term_label = factor(paste(group, term_label, sep = ": "), 
                             levels = paste(group, term_label, sep = ": ")))

# Plot with flipped axes and tilted x-axis labels
p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(
      x = term_label,
      y = -log10(p_value),
      size = intersection_size / term_size,
      fill = group
    )) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Biological Processes",
    y = "-log10(adj.p-value)",
    size = "Gene Ratio",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  ggtitle("MDD genetically associated genes among DEGs") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),  # tilt x-axis labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

cowplot::plot_grid(p, ncol = 1)

```



Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("plots/GO_BP_MDD_combined_all_genes.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

cowplot::plot_grid(p, ncol = 1)

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```
